commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+3' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and AS Roma will take a corner.
90+2' AS Roma take a short corner kick.

90+2' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' Santiago Castro (Bologna) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post.
90+1' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) takes a direct free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
85' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:9. The number of shots on goal at present is 4:2.
83' Substitution. Angelino will be replaced by Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).

83' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
81' The referee awards a corner and Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) goes over to take it.

81' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Remo Freuler will be replaced by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna).
80' Half-chance! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) plays a pass into the box, but Mile Svilar reacts well to snuff out the attack.
79' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
78' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
75' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matias Soule leaves the pitch and Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) comes on.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Evan Ferguson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma).
72' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Jens Odgaard is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nadir Zortea (Bologna) replaces Lorenzo De Silvestri.
71' The referee blows for a cooling break.

69' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Tommaso Pobega (Bologna). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
67' Yellow card. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

67' Matias Soule (AS Roma) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
65' Santiago Castro (Bologna) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
64' An accurate cross picks out Santiago Castro (Bologna) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.

63' Manu Kone (AS Roma) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Stephan El Shaarawy.
57' Matias Soule (AS Roma) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Manu Kone collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.

56' Mile Svilar makes a brilliant save! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!

53' 1 - 0 Goal! The ball breaks to Wesley Franca (AS Roma) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 1:0.
51' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
48' Santiago Castro (Bologna) tries his luck with a shot from long range, and his superb effort rattles the crossbar!

47' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
46' A pass by Wesley Franca (AS Roma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Nicolo Casale limps off the pitch to be replaced by Martin Vitik (Bologna).
46' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Nicolo Casale (Bologna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' Santiago Castro (Bologna) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
44' Manu Kone (AS Roma) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
43' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bologna are going to take it.
41' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AS Roma.

38' A long pass finds Wesley Franca (AS Roma) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
37' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Luca Zufferli who sees an offensive foul.
36' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
36' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
35' Manu Kone (AS Roma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bologna.
33' The ball is cleared after Matias Soule (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bologna.
32' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
31' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes out for a corner. Bologna can continue in their attacking effort.
30' Ciro Immobile is being substituted because of an injury. Vincenzo Italiano sends Santiago Castro (Bologna) on the pitch.
29' Looks like Ciro Immobile (Bologna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
28' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. AS Roma are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
25' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
24' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) jumps into a tackle and Luca Zufferli signals a foul.

23' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His almost perfect header hits the left post and ricochets away off it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
22' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Zufferli signals. AS Roma have a free kick from a promising distance.
22' A long ball forward to Manu Kone (AS Roma) is intercepted.
21' Angelino (AS Roma) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
20' Angelino (AS Roma) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
19' Remo Freuler (Bologna) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
18' Matias Soule (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul. Luca Zufferli had a clear view and blows his whistle.
18' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' A goal, which was scored by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna), was disallowed due to offside.

16' Angelino dinks a cheeky lofted pass into Evan Ferguson (AS Roma), but his headed effort from near the penalty spot goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
15' AS Roma are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

12' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) takes a good first touch from a cross and fires a powerful shot from the edge of the box towards the right post. The goalkeeper, though, is ready and denies him with a brilliant save.
11' A pass into the penalty area from Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is intercepted by the defence. The ball is behind the touchline and AS Roma will take a throw-in.
10' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
8' Half-chance! Angelino (AS Roma) plays a pass into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski reacts well to snuff out the attack.
7' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
5' A great solo run by Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Lukasz Skorupski.
4' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
3' Ciro Immobile (Bologna) dived to the ground without any contact with the opponent.
3' Manu Kone (AS Roma) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli will officiate today.
